subject.title: refactor(talk): return emitted events from the realtime session harness

question: Should the shared `returnEvents` overload remain an internal harness capability for the relay stack, or should maintainers require an explicit public contract decision before landing it?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a generic shared return contract and is a prerequisite for a stacked Plugin SDK feature; source compatibility may be mechanically preserved, but the intended ownership and exposure boundary require maintainer judgment.

options.title: Approve the internal opt-in boundary
options.body: Land the refactor after confirming all non-opt-in callers preserve their existing types and behavior, keeping the returned event-result shapes internal to the harness stack.

options.title: Require an explicit public contract
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether the returned event-result types should be exported and supported as a stable Plugin SDK-facing contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the internal opt-in boundary
recommendation.body: Land the refactor after confirming all non-opt-in callers preserve their existing types and behavior, keeping the returned event-result shapes internal to the harness stack.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged relay-to-harness foundation and authored the current stacked refactor, making them the strongest available feature-history routing candidate.
